g.text: VR-H/I/S/E -> local ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source and native gates OPEN

text.tspan: rc-register
Current PSTATE registration versus processor-0 RC scan
is not a VM-wide root contract
c-closure
Real C closure stores Scheme proc in RC data; callback
self and marker protection remain separate qualified
boundaries
tcl-client
Tcl retains RC client data plus still vector; deletion
releases both; scan observations alone do not prove
current object death
resize-exit
Processor setup/cleanup initializes/frees RC chains;
committed VM roots and their still-object storage must
survive creator processor; root registration alone is
insufficient
gc-phase
Existing GC phase barriers and root partitions are
source seams; registry membership is not
processor_count
register
Reserve initialized slot; producer root protects
payload until atomic VM-root/index receipt handoff;
wrong VM rejects
seal
Close new permits, drain/cancel preaccepted updates
and dereferences, then freeze slot membership and
scanner tickets
scan
Exactly covered slots scanned via mutable root
locations; relocation updates values; registered
readers hold lifetime not raw addresses
retire
Close slot admission; retain until scanner tickets,
update permits, read leases and unresolved receipt
holders all retire
processor-lifetime
Committed slot ownership belongs to VM, not creator
PSTATE; local-only pending roots and still storage
need separate handoff before processor cleanup
vm-root-ownership
Only committed VM-owned slots decouple from processor
exit; no elimination of root scanning
stable-scan
Exact membership can bound scan work; quiescence
delays and slot bookkeeping count
independent-service
Parallel benefit requires actual independent work and
all native writers admitted; no automatic multicore
gain
